The temperature begins to drop in Octobe: Temperatures begin to fall in October, ranging between 14 and 5 degrees, and continue to fall in November. Coats, thermal layers, scarves, woolly hats and gloves are all essential for coping with the cold and enjoying your holiday. Make sure you choose waterproof coats and shoes.

The salt mine is located in a grassy val: The salt mine is located in a grassy valley. The salt rocks in the mine are up to 300 years old. The mine contains statues carved from rock salt, caves and underground lakes. It is lit by a huge chandelier of salt crystals and receives one million visitors a year.
